# shelly_webhook (Resource)

A device-native Webhook (Settings -> Actions in the app): fires an HTTP request to `urls` when `event` occurs on component `cid`. Unlike the generated `shelly_*_config` resources this is a true CRUD object - the device allocates `id` on create and forgets the hook on delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shelly_webhook" "example" {
  ip    = "192.168.1.100"
  cid   = 0
  event = "input.toggle_on"
  name  = "Notify on toggle"
  urls  = ["http://example.com/notify"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cid` (Number) Component instance id the event applies to, e.g. input:0 is cid=0.
- `event` (String) Triggering event, e.g. "input.toggle_on". See Webhook.ListSupported on the device for the valid set per component type.
- `ip` (String) The IP address of the Shelly device.
- `urls` (List of String) HTTP endpoints invoked when the event fires.

### Optional

- `active_between` (List of String) ["HH:MM", "HH:MM"] window the hook is active in, device-local time. Empty means always active.
- `condition` (String) Boolean expression gating whether the hook actually fires.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the hook is active.
- `name` (String) User-defined label, shown in the app's Actions list.
- `repeat_period` (Number) Minimum seconds between invocations; 0 means no rate limit.
- `ssl_ca` (String) TLS validation mode for https urls: null uses the built-in CA, "user_ca.pem" a custom one, "*" disables validation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Webhook id, allocated by the device on create.
